description: Christianity is an Asian religion, and its roots in East Asia go back farther than most may
realize. In this course, students examine case studies of East Asian Christians theological
dialogue with topics that arose in East Asian societies like religious pluralism, Communism,
imperialism and colonialism, martyrdom and persecution, and indigenization. How do these
conversations, meditations, and reflections impact what it means to be a Christian in East Asia?
fullname: Christ in East Asia: Adapting, Responding, and Evolving Theologies (7t
